input.description: The IBAN cell exactly as provided (for joining results back to your data).

source.description: Where the entry came from: "ibans" (list) or "csvText".

position.description: 1-based position among the non-blank entries of that source.

valid.description: true if length, national format and check digits of the IBAN are correct. The BIC does not influence this field.

reasonCode.description: OK, EMPTY, INVALID_CHARACTERS, BAD_PREFIX, UNKNOWN_COUNTRY, WRONG_LENGTH, BAD_BBAN_FORMAT, BAD_CHECKSUM or INTERNAL_ERROR.

iban.description: Normalized IBAN in electronic format (upper case, no separators); null if the input was empty.

ibanFormatted.description: Print format in groups of four; only for valid IBANs.

countryCode.description: ISO country code of the IBAN (once the prefix is well-formed).

checkDigits.description: The two check digits (valid IBANs only).

bban.description: Basic Bank Account Number: everything after country code and check digits (valid IBANs only).

bankCode.description: National bank code where the country format defines it (valid IBANs only).

branchCode.description: Branch / sort code where the country format defines it (valid IBANs only).

accountNumber.description: National account number where the country format defines it (valid IBANs only).

bic.description: The BIC/SWIFT code as normalized (upper case), null if none was provided.

bicValid.description: Whether the BIC has a valid ISO 9362 format; null if none was provided. Format check only, not a directory lookup.

bicReason.description: Why the BIC format is invalid (null otherwise).
